settings.title: Use reviews that mention the fit, finish, and daily feel of the work
settings.text: Strong testimonials mention specifics: flush reveals, smooth drawer action, the warmth of the wood finish, or how a room finally works the way it should.
settings.feature_list:
Precision fit in older homes
Finish quality in natural light
Durability after everyday use
settings.callout_text: What detail do you notice every day now that the piece is installed?

settings.title: Include feedback on communication, scheduling, and installation
settings.text: For custom work, buyers care as much about the process as the finished piece. Reviews that describe responsiveness and clarity reduce hesitation.
settings.feature_list:
Clear quoting and revisions
Accurate scheduling updates
Professional delivery and install
settings.callout_text: Pull the strongest lines from this page into product descriptions, homepage panels, and social content.

settings.title: Testimonials convert better when they explain the problem the build solved
settings.text: Examples include better storage in a narrow mudroom, a dining table sized for a growing family, or shelving that finally uses awkward wall space well.
settings.feature_list:
Storage and organization improvements
Better use of difficult spaces
Pieces sized for real day-to-day needs
settings.callout_text: Favor short, concrete reviews over generic praise. Specificity is the proof.

settings.heading: A dedicated reviews page should reinforce craftsmanship and reliability
settings.intro: Assign this template to a page named Reviews, then replace the placeholder copy with real customer feedback and project-specific outcomes.
